scaling.sampling_disclosure: The paper prints the coupling and nu threshold but not the complete finite-N list; this declared high-density list is reconstructed and cannot alone promote a target to paper_exact.

imaginary_gap.sampling_disclosure: The source gives the observable but not every plotted N/grid value; this grid is declared reconstruction metadata.

phase_portrait.sampling_disclosure: Physical couplings are printed; the paper does not publish its initial-condition coordinates, so an equal-area deterministic grid is a declared render-density choice.

branch.sampling_disclosure: The caption prints the couplings; contour and trajectory sample density are deterministic reconstruction metadata.

recommended_machine.backend: CPU SciPy/BLAS; no GPU is required by this implementation
recommended_machine.cpu: 32 physical x86_64 cores with AVX2 or better
recommended_machine.software: Python 3.11+, NumPy 2.x or compatible, SciPy 1.13+ with threaded MKL/OpenBLAS
recommended_machine.reason: The dominant kernels are dense LAPACK at Liouville dimension 1369, sparse non-Hermitian Arnoldi, and expm_multiply. An A100 would require a separate validated solver and is not on the accepted path.

scheduler.concurrency_rule: One shard index per process; do not launch two writers for the same shard/output root.

checkpoint_policy.dynamics_inner_checkpoint: one density vector plus accumulated magnetization after every 50 new time points
checkpoint_policy.resume_validation: config SHA-256, result SHA-256, and immutable completion marker
checkpoint_policy.aggregation: refuses to run until every configured job is hash-valid

resource_contract.unexecuted_boundary: The repository records CPU smoke/parity/config-load evidence only. Completion markers under outputs/paper_scale must come from the full config before any target is promoted; strict original-reference comparison and protocol-v2 independent review remain separate blockers.

T001.parameter_scope: paper finite sizes and coupling; source display sampling declared
T001.paper_parameter_source: Main Fig. 1(c) labels/caption, main-text initial state, Eq. (2), Supplement Eq. (S7)
acceptance_criteria: Complete N_b=40,80,160 and thermodynamic jobs on the declared time grid.
Maximum finite-N trace error <=2e-8 and thermodynamic norm drift <=2e-6.

T002.paper_parameter_source: Main Fig. 2 caption: N_b=36 and omega_0/kappa=0.5
acceptance_criteria: Complete the entire N_b=36 Liouvillian spectrum at omega_0/kappa=0.5.
Stationary eigenvalue, nonpositive real part, conjugate symmetry and finite-value gates pass.

T003.paper_parameter_source: Main Fig. 2 caption and inset definition
acceptance_criteria: Use the same complete N_b=36 strong-phase spectrum as T002 without a second numerical source.
Leading-mode region passes the spectrum invariants and backend parity gate.

acceptance_criteria: Complete the entire N_b=36 Liouvillian spectrum at omega_0/kappa=1.5.
